remarks: Welcome to 3 Black Birch Road, a beautifully updated home nestled on a private lane. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence has 2,924 square feet of smartly designed living space, perfect for those seeking comfort and style. Step inside to discover a home that has been completely refreshed inside and out. The new roof, Trex deck, windows, new driveway and wood siding ensure easy maintenance. The highlight of the home is the oversized kitchen which opens seamlessly into a large family room with vaulted ceilings and lots of light, creating an inviting space for gatherings and relaxation. The attached garage and additional parking provide ample space for many vehicles. For those who love the outdoors, the property has been professionally landscaped, has a sprinkler system and is completely fenced. It is both private and convenient to all Westport has to offer.
